name: defaults-and-env
base_config:
account:
  email: ${ACME_EMAIL}
  accept_tos: true
dns:
  provider: cloudflare
certificates:
  - name: example
    domains:
      - example.com

name: local-json-override
base_config:
account:
  email: ${ACME_EMAIL}
  accept_tos: true
dns:
  provider: cloudflare
certificates:
  - name: example
    domains:
      - example.com

name: webroot-install-deploy-fields
base_config:
account:
  email: ops@example.com
  accept_tos: true
dns:
  provider: cloudflare
certificates:
  - name: example
    domains:
      - example.com
    challenge: webroot
    webroot_path: public
    install:
      key_file: deploy/live/privkey.pem
      fullchain_file: deploy/live/fullchain.pem
    deploy:
      - name: edge
        type: copy
        directory: deploy/edge
    hooks:
      post_install:
        - echo install
      post_deploy:
        - echo deploy
